title: Kadyal Jawaa Ka Lasha
body:
Akbar.. kadiyal jawaan akbar..(2)
<<MINI>>
kadiyal jawa'n ka laasha khaime mein aa raha hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ka shor e girya..(2)
mehshar utha raha hai
<<MINI>>
kadiyal jawa'n ka laasha khaime mein aa raha hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Paywast hogaya hai seene mein phal sina ka..(2)
haatho se zakhm e naiza..(2)
akbar chupa raha hai
<<MINI>>
kadiyal jawa'n ka laasha..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zakhm e sina ki eeza akbar jawa'n se pucho..(2)
reh reh ke ya ali ka..(2)
naara laga raha hai
<<MINI>>
kadiyal jawa'n ka laasha..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ankho se khul na jaye zakhm e sina ki shiddat..(2)
so yu padar se akbar..(2)
aankhein chupa raha hai
<<MINI>>
kadiyal jawa'n ka laasha..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Uth-ti nahi hai mayyat akbar ki shahe dee'n se..(2)
tharra rahe hai baazu..(2) aur zof cha raha hai
<<MINI>>
kadiyal jawa'n ka laasha..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Attharwa baras tha shaadi ka zamana..(2)
afsos aisi rutt mein..(2)
duniya se jaa raha hai
<<MINI>>
kadiyal jawa'n ka laasha..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Khaime mein shahedee'n ke barpa hai ek mehshar..(2)
marne ko rann mein akbar..(2)
khaime se jaa raha hai
<<MINI>>
kadiyal jawa'n ka laasha..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Nauhe suna raha hai safdar jo majliso mein..(2)
roshan wo is amal se..(2)
jannat kama raha hai
<<MINI>>
kadiyal jawa'n ka laasha..
